slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 清风城外清风山，清风宗。
清风宗在百多年前由清风道人所创，巅峰之时，宗门弟子数百，在方圆百里之内，名声显赫，是为清风城第一宗门。
时过境迁，到今日清风宗早已经没落，而其他宗门则趁机崛起，清风宗被其他门派联手打压，现在只有大鱼小鱼十几只。
“唉，师傅死了，大师兄又被打成重伤，我看清风宗要不了多久，就要被解散了。”
“师兄说的极是，我听说张师兄已经联络了虎拳门，准备带着几位师兄弟一起改投门派了。”
“师弟我也听说了，这虎拳门短短十几年就发展如此规模，听说其背后还有一流势力支持，张师兄他们要发达了。”
“诸位师兄师弟，现在清风宗都这样了，我们若是还留在这里，定没有什么大好前途，不如学张师兄一起改投虎拳门。”
“周师兄说的极是，不是我们忘恩负义，我们拜入清风宗是为了出人头地，而不是等死。”
清风宗仅剩下的十几个弟子背着包袱，招呼不打一声，瞬间跑的精光。
而这一切都被秦叶看在眼里。
“大师兄，这些人都跑光了，门派就没人了，你为什么不阻拦他们下山？”秦叶身边一个十几岁的小姑娘气鼓鼓地说道。
她正是秦叶的师妹武萱儿。
“他们有了异心，想下山就下山吧。强留在这里也不见得是什么好事。”秦叶无所谓笑了笑，说道。
“可是他们都走了，宗门怎么办？”
“宗门的事你不用担心，我已经想到办法了。”
“真哒！我就知道大师兄无所不能。”武萱儿开心地笑道，看向秦叶的双眸充满了爱慕神色。
实际上，此时的秦叶并不是之前的秦叶，而是被鸠占鹊巢，现在的灵魂来自于21世纪一个宅男。
因为某种原因灵魂穿越到这个世界，占据了这个身体，只是让他没有想到的是，结局并不太好，其原身所在的门派刚刚经历过变故，已经到了破产的边缘。
清风宗老宗主半个月前去城主府赴宴，但是在归来的途中遭遇到暗算，被找到时就已经凉透了。
而秦叶当时陪老宗主一起同去赴宴，同样受了重伤，奄奄一息，这才给了他鸠占鹊巢的机会。
门中弟子看到老宗主死了，而大师兄又身受重伤，人心自然就散了。
秦叶理解他们，这就像一个公司，老板挂了，接班人也不行了，员工自然就跑路了，所以也就不那么难接受了。
但是，现在摆在秦叶面前的是生存的问题。
老宗主已经死了，他现在就是新的宗主，而现在整个宗门上下，也就只有他和师妹两个人。
content_en:
Qingfeng Mountain outside Qingfeng City is home to the Qingfeng Sect.
The Qingfeng Sect was founded by Taoist Qingfeng more than a hundred years ago. At its peak, the sect had hundreds of disciples and was famous within a radius of a hundred miles. It was the number one sect in Qingfeng City.
Time has passed, and today the Qingfeng Sect has long since declined, while other sects have taken the opportunity to rise. The Qingfeng Sect has been jointly suppressed by other sects, and now there are only a dozen big fish and small fish.
"Alas, the master is dead, and the senior brother was seriously injured. I see that Qingfeng Sect will be disbanded soon."
"Senior brother is absolutely right. I heard that senior brother Zhang has contacted the Tiger Fist Sect and is preparing to join several other sects with him."
"Junior brother, I have also heard that the Tiger Fist Sect has developed to such a scale in just a dozen years. I heard that there are first-class forces behind it. Senior Brother Zhang and the others are about to become prosperous."
"Senior brothers and sisters, the Qingfeng Sect is like this now. If we still stay here, we will not have a good future. We might as well follow the example of Senior Brother Zhang and join the Tiger Fist Sect."
"Senior Brother Zhou is absolutely right. We are not ungrateful. We joined the Qingfeng Sect to get ahead, not to wait for death."
The remaining dozen or so disciples of the Qingfeng Sect were all carrying their burdens and ran away in an instant without even saying hello.
And all this was seen by Qin Ye.
"Elder brother, these people have all run away, and there is no one left in the sect. Why don't you stop them from going down the mountain?" A teenage girl next to Qin Ye said angrily.
She is Qin Ye's junior sister Wu Xuan'er.
"They have different intentions. If you want to go down the mountain, just go down. It's not necessarily a good thing to force them to stay here." Qin Ye smiled nonchalantly and said.
"But they are all gone, what will happen to the sect?"
"Don't worry about the sect, I have already thought of a way."
"That's true! I knew that senior brother could do anything." Wu Xuan'er smiled happily, looking at Qin Ye with eyes full of admiration.
In fact, Qin Ye at this time is not the Qin Ye before, but was occupied by a dove, and his current soul comes from an otaku in the 21st century.
For some reason, the soul traveled to this world and occupied this body. What he didn't expect was that the ending was not very good. The sect where the original body belonged had just experienced changes and was on the verge of bankruptcy.
The old leader of the Qingfeng Sect went to the City Lord's Mansion for a banquet half a month ago, but he was assassinated on the way back and was already cold when he was found.
At that time, Qin Ye accompanied the old sect leader to a banquet. He was also seriously injured and was dying. This gave him the opportunity to occupy the magpie's nest.
When the disciples saw that the old sect leader was dead and the senior brother was seriously injured, their hearts naturally went apart.
Qin Ye understands them. It's like a company. If the boss dies and the successor is gone, the employees will naturally run away, so it's not that difficult to accept.
However, what Qin Ye faces now is the problem of survival.
The old sect leader is dead, he is now the new sect leader, and now there are only two people in the entire sect, namely him and his junior sister.
